items: (a) Check that there is continuity between terminals 1 and 2 when the switch is on.
(b) Check that there is no continuity between terminals 1 and 2 when the switch is off.

content.text: If continuity is not as specified, replace the switch.

content.description: Diagram showing outside handle switch testing with multimeter. The switch has two positions marked 'ON' and 'OFF'. Terminals 1 and 2 are indicated on the switch connector. A multimeter is shown connected to test continuity.
